findings.title: Handle authorized requests without an organization member
findings.body: Organization-scoped API credentials can authorize access without a user membership, leaving organization_context.member as None. For those requests, request.user.is_superuser is false and this expression raises AttributeError. Because it is evaluated even when optimized_pagination is absent, this also breaks previously working requests using the default paginator. Only evaluate the advanced-access check when needed and explicitly handle a missing member.

findings.title: Preserve datetime cursor conversion for audit logs
findings.body: The audit-log endpoint uses this paginator with order_by="-datetime", so get_item_key receives a datetime.datetime value. math.floor and math.ceil cannot handle that type and raise TypeError while building cursors for any nonempty page. value_from_cursor also returns the numeric cursor value unchanged instead of converting it back to a datetime for the database comparison. The optimized audit-log path needs DateTimePaginator's key and cursor conversions to work at all.

findings.title: Django QuerySets do not support negative slicing
findings.body: With advanced features enabled, a negative cursor offset is passed directly to a Django QuerySet slice. Django rejects negative start or stop indices with ValueError("Negative indexing is not supported"); it does not handle the boundaries automatically as the comment claims. For example, cursor=0:-1:0 makes the optimized audit-log request fail before retrieving any rows. Implement reverse traversal using supported ordering and nonnegative slices, or reject such offsets with a pagination error.
